description: The most recent commit (1c1b267) documents a coverage gap for byKey OcspResponderIdMismatch. The verify_responder_id_impl function (ocsp.rs line 464) handles byKey (line 475-480) using SHA-1 of the SPKI raw bytes, but the OCSP test fixtures in tests/ocsp_checker_tests.rs only test byName responses. There is no test that exercises the byKey branch — not even a stub with a mismatched hash. The byKey SHA-1 computation (line 477: sha1::Sha1::digest(spki_raw)) has not been independently validated against a reference. This is a test coverage gap on security-critical identity verification logic.
title: OCSP byKey ResponderId coverage gap documented but no test verifies byKey path is reachable
